title: FY27 Incentive Decision Register
description: Machine-readable contract for the FY27 incentive decision-closure gate (Phase 3A). This is the SCHEMA only -- it contains no real Leadership/Finance decisions, no employee data, no compensation figures. The real register lives in the gitignored incentive_working/ directory (FY27_INCENTIVE_DECISION_REGISTER.json) and must validate against this file. See incentive_working/FY27_INCENTIVE_DECISION_REGISTER.md for the human-readable rendering and full evidence per decision.

decision_id.description: Must be a known decision family ID. See REQUIRED_DECISIONS in scripts/incentive_control/models.py for the current canonical list.

affected_value_l.description: Rupees Lakh, when the decision has a discrete Rs exposure. null for basis decisions (D1A/D1B) which are not a line item. Consumers must NOT sum affected_value_l across decisions -- several decisions share underlying rows (see overlap_of in the register's own documentation) and this schema does not encode which; that lives in target_scope_decision_pack.md section D0.

allowed_responses.description: The exact, deterministic token set this decision accepts. selected_response, when set, must be one of these.

selected_response.description: Must be null unless current_status is APPROVED, REJECTED, or NOT_APPLICABLE, and must then be one of allowed_responses.

approved_by.description: Required (non-blank) when current_status == APPROVED. Never set by an automated agent -- only by a person recording a real response.

evidence_reference.description: Required (non-blank) when current_status == APPROVED -- the email/thread/document where the response was recorded.

business_rule_result.description: Must be null while current_status is any PENDING_*, BLOCKED_CONFLICT, or CLARIFICATION_REQUIRED value -- an unresolved decision produces no business-rule result.

content_hash.description: Optional, backward-compatible (added alongside PR #215's evidence-gap fix). A fingerprint over affected_period/affected_entity/affected_value_l/affected_store_count/allowed_responses, stamped by record_incentive_decision.py whenever a decision is resolved (APPROVED/REJECTED/NOT_APPLICABLE). record_incentive_decision.py has no flag to change these content fields at all, so a mismatch between this and the content actually present means the register was hand-edited outside the sanctioned CLI -- is_resolved_with_evidence() then treats the decision as unresolved again, rather than trusting a stale approval attached to changed content.

revision_history.description: Phase 3B (STEP 5): optional, backward-compatible. Populated only when an already-APPROVED decision's response changes -- the prior approval is preserved here, never overwritten in place. Absent or empty on a decision that has never been amended.

decision_version.description: 1 is the original approval (not itself a revision entry); this is the version the change moved TO.

change_evidence.description: A NEW evidence reference for this specific change -- never the original approval's evidence_reference reused.
